workflow.name: Cosmos ABCI Consensus Halt Review v2
workflow.description: Scope-gated enumeration of production ABCI surfaces, independent panic-class hypothesis fan-out, root-cause deduplication, hostile verification, local multi-node PoC, eligibility mapping, and relative ranking. Import-valid v2.2: globally unique stage output keys, one consume-all dedup boundary, immutable program extras after dedup, deterministic mapping, high-priority PoC gating, and explicit Web3 fork inputs.

steps.name: Freeze program scope contract
Enumerate production ABCI surfaces
steps.content:
Map every production-reachable ABCI method or phase handler in in-scope Cosmos/CometBFT code at {{commit_sha}}: application methods, BaseApp/module manager wiring, Begin/End/PreBlockers, proposal and vote-extension handlers, snapshot paths, transaction paths, and registered keeper hooks. Prove ordered construction/registration/runtime reachability. Identify the least-privileged runtime actors and inputs, prior attacker-writable state, recovery boundary, and whether the supplied accepted impacts include chain halt or consensus divergence. Exclude tests, examples, build-tag-inactive code, unregistered generated code, and local-only startup failures. One record per concrete phase handler. No vulnerability claims.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: explicit and helper panics
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Trace only callees reachable during this ABCI phase. Emit one hypothesis per attacker-triggerable direct panic, Must/require/assert helper, codec/store panic, reflection panic, or dependency panic candidate. For each, prove a candidate actor/input/state source, suspected panic site, consensus propagation mechanism, guard candidates, exact verification locations, accepted-impact candidate, and strongest falsification target. No finding yet.

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: arithmetic and numeric state
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Enumerate reachable divisors, modulo operands, big-int/decimal helpers, conversions, total power/supply/rate denominators, and nil numeric values. Emit only code-grounded hypotheses where an untrusted transaction/proposer/validator/IBC/oracle/governance-reachable state can create the invalid value at the panic site. Include exact arithmetic and falsification guard. No finding yet.

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: nil, bounds, types, decoders
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Inspect reachable dereferences, lookup results, ignored errors, typed-nil interfaces, collection indexes/slices, type assertions, reflection, protobuf/custom decoders, and empty-after-filter cases. Emit one record per precise actor-controlled panic hypothesis with source-to-site trace, state prerequisite, consensus propagation theory, candidate guards, and falsification target. No finding yet.

steps.name: Consensus hypotheses: determinism and resource asymmetry
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Hunt deterministic consensus failures beyond language panics: non-deterministic iteration/time/randomness/external reads, inconsistent validation between CheckTx/DeliverTx/ProcessProposal, proposer/validator disagreement, gas-meter bypass, and bounded attacker-controlled CPU/memory/state amplification capable of stopping block progress under program rules. Emit only hypotheses tied to exact code and a non-volume-dependent trigger. No finding yet.

steps.name: Deduplicate consensus root causes
steps.content: Review {{multi_output_depth_2}}. Merge hypotheses sharing the same panic/divergence operation, attacker primitive, required state, consensus effect, and fix. Emit canonical records with stable fingerprints. Preserve distinct trigger paths and conflicting evidence. Discard local-node-only crashes without accepted impact, configuration-only failures, unreachable code, generic hardening, and volume-only DDoS.

steps.name: Independent consensus-halt verification
steps.content: Act as a separate hostile verifier for {{dedup_canonical_hypothesis_id}}. Reconstruct transaction/proposal/state creation -> ABCI registration -> target phase -> exact panic/divergence/resource site -> effect on consensus progress. Prove the attacker role can create every prerequisite without privileged or unsupported configuration. Inspect ante/message validation, proposal checks, SDK recovery, cache/transaction rollback, process supervisors, deterministic execution, and whether enough nodes encounter the same effect. Falsify if recovery contains it, only one optional node fails, the input cannot enter a committed/proposed block, or a mandatory guard dominates. Return supported/falsified/blocked and a local multi-node reproduction plan.

steps.name: Local multi-node PoC gate
steps.content:
For supported candidates, build the smallest authorized deterministic reproduction pinned to {{commit_sha}} using unit/integration tests, a local multi-validator network, simulator, or fuzzer. Capture the malicious transaction/proposal/state setup, panic stack or divergence evidence, nodes affected, and before/after block height or consensus progress. Repeat when practical. Do not touch public networks. Set reproduced, deterministically_proven, not_reproduced, or blocked and preserve exact evidence/artifacts.

Cost gate: if {{dedup_triage_priority}} is not `high`, do not build or run a harness. Return poc_verdict=`skipped_by_priority` with the reason. For smart-contract candidates, use {{extra.fork_rpc_url}} and {{extra.fork_block}} when supplied.

steps.name: Apply program eligibility gate
steps.content:
Apply the immutable program scope contract to this technically verified candidate.
Program evidence is read directly from immutable extras after dedup: snapshot={{extra.program_rules_snapshot}}; checked_at={{extra.program_rules_checked_at}}; URL={{extra.bug_bounty_url}}; deployment={{extra.deployment_evidence}}; known_issues={{extra.known_issues_snapshot}}; testing_constraints={{extra.authorized_test_constraints}}.
Candidate: {{dedup_canonical_summary}}. Root cause: {{dedup_canonical_root_cause}} at {{dedup_canonical_location}}.
Technical verdict: {{verify_technical_verdict}}. Production reachability: {{verify_production_reachability}}.
Observed effect: {{poc_observed_effect}}. Reproduction verdict: {{poc_poc_verdict}}. Reproduction evidence: {{poc_poc_evidence}}.

Set eligibility_verdict=eligible only when the exact affected asset is in scope, the observed effect matches a named accepted impact, no exclusion or known-issue rule controls, and required deployment facts are evidenced. Use ineligible for a controlling exclusion or absent impact; use blocked for missing program/deployment facts. Assign severity only from the supplied program language and measured impact. Do not use popularity, theoretical TVL, scanner confidence, or remembered platform conventions.

steps.name: Report verified Cosmos finding
